summary: Tested backend (17/17 pytest pass: auth register/login/me/logout, projects CRUD + summary + two-user isolation, items CRUD + module filter + cascade delete, upload + files?token) and the frontend at iPad landscape 1180x820 and phone 390x844. These work: login (wrong-password error shown), Google button present, register, session survives reload, logout, protected-route redirect, dark/light theme toggle, create project, all sidebar navigation, generic list add/edit/delete (Scene, Shotlist with check toggle and strikethrough, Budget total 1750,50 that persists after reload, Cast, Note), Storyboard drawing/save/thumbnail, Lighting add/drag/save, Slate clap (take 1->3, 2 logs), Time tracker start/stop, Meteo Roma (14 days + sun data), Lens/Formati/Frame guides values, Overview edit persists, PDF exports open a print window with no crash, phone hub list -> module -> back. Bugs found: (1) in the web preview, pressing Enter in the Screenplay editor adds a newline inside the same block instead of creating a new block; (2) deleting a project, the back-to-projects button and 'Torna ai progetti' all call router.back() and fail with an unhandled GO_BACK error when there is no navigation history (deep link or reload), so the user is stuck on the hub; (3) security: registering with the email of an existing Google-only account sets a password on that account and returns a session (account takeover). No deprecated Expo packages detected.

critical.issue: If a user exists without password_hash (Google-only account), register sets a new password on that account and returns a session token. Anyone who knows a Google user's email can take over the account. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:230-236

minor.issue: A password shorter than 6 characters returns Pydantic 422 with a list 'detail', so the frontend shows the raw text 'Errore 422' (api.ts:51-53 only handles a string detail).

ui_bugs.issue:
In the web preview, Enter inserts '
' into the current block instead of creating the next block. react-native-web 0.21.4 ignores submitBehavior='submit'; for a multiline input it only calls onSubmitEditing when blurOnSubmit is truthy. The saved value then contains embedded newlines (e.g. 'INT. CUCINA - NOTTE
MARCO ENTRA LENTAMENTE.
'). Native iPad is probably fine. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ScreenplayEditor.tsx:114-117

router.back() is used with no fallback. Opening a project by URL (or after a reload) and then deleting it, pressing back-to-projects-button or pressing 'Torna ai progetti' shows the red toast "The action 'GO_BACK' was not handled" and the user stays on the hub of the deleted project. The project is deleted on the backend (404). References: /app/frontend/src/components/Overview.tsx:39, /app/frontend/app/project/[id].tsx:74, :90

integration_issues.issue: Sun times (alba/tramonto/golden hour) are formatted in the device timezone (toLocaleTimeString without timeZone), not the timezone of the searched location. Planning a shoot in another timezone shows the wrong hours. Reference: /app/frontend/src/sun.ts:58

issues: New elements spawn at the same center point, so Camera and Attore overlap and their labels are unreadable until dragged apart. Offset each new element.
The type chip row is clipped at the right edge ('Doc…') with no scroll hint at 1180px.

action_items: HIGH: ScreenplayEditor: make Enter create a new block on web. For example on Platform.OS==='web' set blurOnSubmit={true} (or handle onKeyPress key==='Enter' without Shift: preventDefault + insertAfter) and keep submitBehavior for native.
HIGH (security): /api/auth/register: return 409 for ANY existing email, including Google-only accounts. Do not attach a password to an existing account without proving ownership.
MEDIUM: Replace router.back() with `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/')` in Overview.tsx:39 (after delete) and project/[id].tsx:74,90.
LOW: api.ts error parsing: when detail is an array, show detail[0].msg (or validate password length and email on the client) instead of 'Errore 422'.
LOW: Format sun times with the location's timezone (open-meteo returns 'timezone' when timezone=auto); pass it as timeZone to toLocaleTimeString.
LOW: Lighting diagram: offset the spawn position of newly added elements.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py register flow allows a Google account takeover (see backend critical).
Items have no module whitelist on the server (any string is accepted). Acceptable, but consider validating against the known module keys.
expo.out.log contains one 'Linking did not produce an initial navigation state' error from NavigationContainer during a web render. The app works; monitor whether it recurs.
No deprecated packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) found in package.json.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (2 of 17 tested flows have bugs: screenplay Enter on web, navigation after delete with no history)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI Film project 91221bd9-c56b-4a47-9cdf-065070ce9fe5 (deleted via the UI at the end). Registered UI user test_ui_54081@example.com (no delete endpoint). Pytest creates test_*@example.com users and TEST_ projects and cleans up the projects. Admin's existing projects 'Il Faro' and 'TEST_UI Film' (55768968...) were not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (the frontend .env has no EXPO_BACKEND_URL key). pytest.ini uses xdist (-n). Field testIDs in the item editor are field-<key>, chips are field-<key>-option-<value>. Log in fresh in each browser run. Retest screenplay Enter on web and delete-project navigation after opening the project by direct URL.
rca_of_issue: Screenplay Enter: in node_modules/react-native-web/dist/exports/TextInput/index.js:282, onSubmitEditing only fires when (blurOnSubmit || !multiline); submitBehavior is not supported in rn-web 0.21.4. GO_BACK: expo-router router.back() has no history entry when the route is opened directly or after a reload.
